name: io.github.oren198/strata
description: Shared memory for a fleet of AI coding agents, checked by an LLM judge before it lands.

environmentVariables.name: JUDGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the judge endpoint (OpenRouter by default, or an Anthropic-Messages-compatible endpoint set via JUDGE_BASE_URL).

environmentVariables.name: JUDGE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Anthropic-Messages-compatible judge endpoint. Defaults to OpenRouter.

environmentVariables.name: JUDGE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model id the judge calls at JUDGE_BASE_URL.

environmentVariables.name: STRATA_AGENT_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: The scope this agent session is bound to.

environmentVariables.name: STRATA_AGENT_SKILL
environmentVariables.description: The skill identity this agent session acts as.

environmentVariables.name: STRATA_AGENT_SESSION_ID
environmentVariables.description: A stable id for this agent session.
